title: DNA/RNA Extraction from Fresh-Frozen Tissue Using AllPrep Kit
author: Annika Fendler
materials: QC: Qubit Qubit RNA BR Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q10211 and tape station RNA ScreenTape and Reagents Agilent Technologies
QC: Qubit DNA Qubit™ dsDNA BR Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32853 and tape station Genomic DNA ScreenTape Agilent Technologies Catalog #5067-5365

steps.title: Prepare tissue lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue into a 2 mL DNA LoBind tube containing RLT + β‑ME; add 350 µL for up to 10 mg tissue or 600 µL for 10–30 mg (or stabilised tissue). Keep the tissue frozen (do not let it defrost).

steps.title: Bead‑beat tissue
steps.instruction: Add one 5 mm bead to each tube and place the tubes in a TissueLyser II. Lyse for 2 min at 20 Hz.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes for 1 min at 9 000 × g (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Second bead‑beat
steps.instruction: Turn the tube rack and lyse the tissue again for 2 min at 20 Hz in the TissueLyser.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysate for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Centrifuge post‑incubation
steps.instruction: Spin the lysate for 1 min at 9 000 × g (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Load lysate onto DNA column
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared lysate to a DNA Mini Spin Column placed in a collection tube.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K to column
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K: 50 µL for up to 10 mg tissue or 80 µL for 10–30 mg (or stabilised tissue). Mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Add ethanol and bind DNA
steps.instruction: Add ethanol (absolute): 200 µL for up to 10 mg tissue or 350 µL for 10–30 mg (or stabilised tissue). Mix by inverting, then spin the column.

steps.title: Centrifuge and repeat if needed
steps.instruction: Spin for 30 s at maximum speed (°C not specified). If any liquid remains on the column, repeat the spin.

steps.title: Store column at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Transfer the DNA Mini Spin Column to a new collection tube and store at 4 °C until DNA extraction is performed.

steps.title: Collect flow‑through for RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the flow‑through from the DNA column to a new 2 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Add ethanol to flow‑through
steps.instruction: Add ethanol (absolute): 400 µL for up to 10 mg tissue or 750 µL for 10–30 mg (or stabilised tissue). Mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Bind RNA to RNeasy column
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of the ethanol‑treated flow‑through to an RNeasy Spin Column. Spin for 30 s at maximum speed (°C not specified) and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Repeat binding until cleared
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step until all liquid has passed through the RNeasy column.

steps.title: Add RPE buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL RPE buffer to the RNeasy column.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: Spin for 30 s at maximum speed (°C not specified) and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Digest DNA with DNase I
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL DNase I working solution directly onto the membrane and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add FRN buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL FRN buffer to the column.

steps.title: Centrifuge without discarding flow‑through
steps.instruction: Spin for 30 s at maximum speed (°C not specified) and do NOT discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Re‑apply flow‑through to column
steps.instruction: Add the previously retained flow‑through back onto the column.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: Spin for 30 s at maximum speed (°C not specified) and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Add second RPE wash
steps.instruction: Add another 500 µL RPE buffer to the column.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: Spin for 30 s at maximum speed (°C not specified) and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Add absolute ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL absolute ethanol to the column.

steps.title: Centrifuge and transfer to new tube (2 ml)
steps.instruction: Spin for 2 min at maximum speed (°C not specified) and place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and transfer to new tube (1.5 ml)
steps.instruction: Spin for 2 min at maximum speed (°C not specified) and place the column in a new 1.5 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Add RNase‑free water
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL RNase‑free H₂O directly onto the membrane.

steps.title: Incubate
steps.instruction: Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Spin for 1 min at 8 000 × g (°C not specified).

steps.title: Add AW1 wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL AW1 to the DNA Mini Spin Column.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: Spin for 30 s at maximum speed (°C not specified) and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K working solution
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL Proteinase K working solution directly onto the membrane.

steps.title: Incubate
steps.instruction: Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add second AW1 wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL AW1 to the column.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: Spin for 30 s at maximum speed (°C not specified) and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Add AW2 wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL AW2 to the column.

steps.title: Centrifuge and transfer to new tube (2 ml)
steps.instruction: Spin for 2 min at maximum speed (°C not specified) and place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and transfer to new tube (1.5 ml)
steps.instruction: Spin for 1 min at maximum speed (°C not specified) and place the column in a new 1.5 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA with EB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL EB buffer (Qiagen Catalog #19086) directly onto the membrane.

steps.title: Incubate
steps.instruction: Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin down for 1 min at 8 000 × g (°C not specified) to collect the eluate.
